_comment: Versioned gate thresholds for `make eval` / `python -m citeval.eval`. Seeded from the cal30 offline baseline (results_cal30.jsonl x graded_reference_v2) WITH margin. `thresholds` are hard floors/ceilings; `baseline` is the reference point for the zero-objective-regression guard (any objective axis dropping below baseline is a breach even if it still clears the floor). After an intended, reviewed change, reseed the `baseline` block below with the fresh measured numbers via `make baseline` (== `python -m citeval.eval --print-baseline`), and bump `thresholds_version`.
code_version_seeded: f99d21f (graded, frozen) + WO-C3 scope over-generalization (objective scope axis)

scope_recall._note: WO-C3 (2026-07-13): floor lowered 0.95->0.90 and baseline 1.0->0.909 when the regen_results._LIVE_SCOPE_OVERRIDES props were REMOVED — cal30 scope now stands on the real deterministic Opus-C3 result. The improved C3 catches Bs22 natively (species: a Humans-scoped claim citing an animal-only source). Bp01 (a bare general human claim citing an INFANT-only paper) is a genuine, honest FN: the identical general-claim-vs-pediatric-source pattern is labelled SUPPORTED for controls Ce03/Ce11 in the same reference, so flagging it would false-positive genuine controls below the specificity floor (a claim-context distinction a claim-only scope parse cannot see). 10/11 scope mismatches caught. The regression guard (baseline 0.909) still catches any real drop below the honest capability.

baseline._reseed_note: Reseeded at thresholds_version 4 (WO-C3 scope over-generalization) after the C3 fix that catches implicit-species and pediatric/pregnancy population over-generalizations. GRADED axis UNCHANGED (frozen C4 predictions from f99d21f re-joined; graded_exact/adjacent/qwk/coverage/ECE/confident-wrong byte-identical to v3). ONLY scope_recall moved: 1.0 (propped via regen_results._LIVE_SCOPE_OVERRIDES) -> 0.909 honest, when both props were removed. Bs22 now caught natively (species); Bp01 is a genuine deterministic FN (general human claim citing an infant-only source — indistinguishable at claim level from the SUPPORTED Ce03/Ce11 controls, so not flagged to hold the specificity floor). scope_precision 1.0, control_specificity 1.0 both held. (Held-out ext-45 under this C3: scope recall 0.294->~0.71, precision 0.83->0.92, specificity 0.94 held — reported separately, ext gate untouched.)
baseline._confident_wrong_note: GENUINE errors (a_exact >= confident_wrong_tau AND ordinal-distance >= confident_wrong_min_distance): NONE. All 27 graded cases are within +/-1 of the reference. 8 confident-but-adjacent cases (A09, A10, A13, A17, Bp01, Bs07, Ch03, Ch10) remain info-only — adjacency on the 6-level scale is not an error.
